title: Hedge-Bench: Benchmarking Agents on Hard, Realistic Tasks Pertaining to Financial Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2606.03918v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Modern AI agents are increasingly capable of routine financial-analysis tasks such as retrieving documents and updating spreadsheets. A harder challenge is forecasting an unknown future from incomplete information. Public markets provide a natural testbed: analysts routinely predict discrete events with information from that point in time. We present Hedge-Bench, a benchmark of 92 real-world environments derived from hedge fund analysts' reasoning traces paired with subsequently resolved prediction questions. Agents reason from frozen information snapshots, and their forecasts are evaluated against real-world outcomes. Across 11 frontier models and three trials per environment, joint success rates, which require both a correct forecast and over 60% research coverage, range from 2.54 to 31.52%. translated_title: Hedge-Bench：面向金融推理的高难度现实任务智能体基准测试
translated_abstract: 现代AI智能体在检索文档、更新电子表格等常规金融分析任务上的能力日益增强。更具挑战性的难题是从不完整的信息中预测未知的未来。公开市场为此提供了一个天然的测试平台：分析师们通常基于当时可获得的信息来预测离散事件。我们提出了Hedge-Bench，这是一个包含92个真实世界环境的基准，这些环境源自对冲基金分析师的推理轨迹，并配以随后已揭晓结果的预测问题。智能体基于冻结的信息快照进行推理，其预测结果将依据真实世界的结果进行评估。在11个前沿模型、每个环境进行三次试验的设置下，联合成功率（要求同时具备正确的预测和超过60%的研究覆盖率）范围为2.54%至31.52%。利用带有回合级信用分配的GRPO方法，我们在165个环境上训练了Muse-Glimmer模型，将22个保留环境上的覆盖率从……（原文摘要至此截断）。
tldr: 提出了Hedge-Bench基准——基于对冲基金分析师真实推理轨迹和已揭晓市场结果构建的92个环境，用于评估AI智能体在不完整信息下的金融预测能力，发现前沿模型的联合成功率仅为2.54%至31.52%。
en_tdlr: Hedge-Bench is a benchmark of 92 real-world environments built from hedge fund analysts' reasoning traces and later-resolved prediction questions, revealing that frontier agents achieve joint success rates of only 2.54–31.52% on hard, realistic financial forecasting tasks.
